text: Alumnae Theatre Company is one of Toronto’s oldest continuous theatre organizations, with a history dating back to 1918. As a volunteer-run, not-for-profit organization dedicated to skills development for women in theatre, Alumnae Theatre has played a significant role in the city’s cultural landscape, providing opportunities for artists, technicians, and audiences to engage in high-quality, community-based theatre. Operating from a City-owned heritage property at 70 Berkeley Street, the organization has contributed to the vitality of downtown Toronto for decades, supporting local economic activity while fostering a diverse and inclusive arts community. Its longstanding presence reflects a deep commitment to accessible cultural programming and to nurturing emerging and established talent alike.
